items.paraphrase: Aucun has a literary positive meaning in interrogative, doubtful or negative-colored clauses; as a pronoun it can mean anyone, and with negation none.
items.contextualInference: Unit 176 denies that any combatant claims the land; unit 178 says almost none has seen the ruler. The two contextual meanings share proper pronoun ownership, with the negative meaning shared with Chapter II.

items.paraphrase: Pas trop can indicate guère, a small degree.
items.contextualInference: The giant says he understands Greek not particularly well in unit 198.

items.paraphrase: Fétu denotes a straw and occurs in figurative expressions for something of negligible value.
items.contextualInference: In unit 176, the straw illustrates that a combatant claims not even the slightest thing on the disputed land.

items.paraphrase: Sultan is a sovereign title, including that of Ottoman sovereigns.
items.contextualInference: The source contrasts rulers called Sultan and César; capitalization does not create a separate personal-name sense.
